excerpt_i18n.en: According to Leifeng Network, on November 26, 2025, Qualcomm officially launched the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 mobile platform. The debut of this new product marks the complete implementation of the "dual flagship" layout for the Snapdragon 8 series, forming a differentiated positioning alongside the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Ultimate Edition released in September, together covering different demand scenarios in the high-end mobile chip market. Specifically, the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Ultimate Edition, with its core configuration of a 4.6GHz high-frequency Oryon CPU, 18MB of dedicated GPU memory, and a full-slice architecture, targets the ultra-high-end market above 5,000 yuan, designed specifically for top-tier flagship models pursuing ultimate performance. In contrast, the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8, with a 3.8GHz CPU frequency, 4MB of shared cache, and an optimized GPU slice design, further balances performance and power consumption while retaining the core advantages of the same-generation architecture, precisely fitting the mainstream flagship price range of 3,000 to 5,000 yuan, allowing more consumers to experience flagship-level technology. "We have introduced the custom-designed Oryon CPU into this tier. With this custom CPU, the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 brings a revolutionary performance improvement, with single-core performance increasing by 35% and multi-core performance by 36% compared to the previous generation," said Ma Xiaomin, Senior Director of Product Marketing at Qualcomm Technologies. As a core new member of the Snapdragon flagship product portfolio, the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8, with its new positioning, achieves comprehensive breakthroughs in six core dimensions: performance, power efficiency, AI, imaging, gaming, and connectivity, precisely meeting consumers' diverse needs for high-end mobile experiences. Single-core performance is improved by 35%.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según informa Leifeng, el 26 de noviembre de 2025, Qualcomm lanzó oficialmente la plataforma móvil Snapdragon 8 de quinta generación. La llegada de este nuevo producto marca la implementación completa de la estrategia de "doble buque insignia" de la serie Snapdragon 8, diferenciándose del Snapdragon 8 Elite de quinta generación lanzado en septiembre, cubriendo conjuntamente diferentes escenarios de demanda en el mercado de chips móviles de gama alta. En concreto, el Snapdragon 8 Elite de quinta generación se centra en el mercado ultra premium por encima de 5000 yuanes, diseñado específicamente para dispositivos insignia de máximo rendimiento, con configuraciones clave como CPU Oryon de alta frecuencia de 4.6 GHz, 18 MB de memoria dedicada para GPU y arquitectura de segmentación completa. Por su parte, el Snapdragon 8 de quinta generación cuenta con una frecuencia principal de CPU de 3.8 GHz.

excerpt_i18n.en: Claude cut off access abruptly, leaving AWS Greater China with no room to maneuver. Recently, multiple foreign cloud sales personnel reported to Leifeng.com that shortly after Anthropic, the developer of the Claude large model, issued an "AI supply cutoff order" to Chinese enterprises, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Greater China removed the Claude model from its Bedrock platform, also losing two major clients, ByteDance and Tencent. "ByteDance was a major client on AWS Greater China's Bedrock platform, contributing an MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) of $8–9 million. Additionally, Tencent's CodeBuddy also had a significant volume. Now, all of that is gone."
